skeptic: Verified all three modules line by line. token-verifier.js checks string type and Bearer prefix cleanly. rate-limiter.js mutates counters without bounding map growth or handling backward clock jumps.
builder: Each module is small and isolated. Adding an explicit non-monotonic clock check in rate-limiter.js and null-safe record guard in session-store.js keeps the helpers dependency-free.
dreamer: Across rate-limiter.js and session-store.js, caller-supplied timestamps are trusted without checking Number.isFinite(nowMs). NaN timestamps bypass window resets and drop all sessions.
empath: Clear reason codes in token-verifier.js help callers debug failed requests without leaking key material, while silent NaN handling in rate-limiter.js and session-store.js makes clock bugs hard to diagnose.
